text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning on a day off, as I walked past 
the dance studio, I spotted Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four~ Heave-ho, 
heave-ho~âª
choice_data_list:
Practicing on your day off? That's 
impressive!
Practicing on your day off? Good for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, up early on your day off, are you~? 
I've decided to learn some new dance 
choreography today, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
For now, I am simply warming up to get my 
body going~.
choice_data_list: You really are devoted to practice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not at all~. I'm just much, much 
slo~wer at learning choreography than 
everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if we are to put on a Winning 
Live, I want to show everyone the best 
performance possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am, after all, a proud daughter of the 
Mejiro family~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's both have a wonderful 
day. Have a lovely afternoon~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just after dusk, I remembered some errand 
at the trainer's office and passed by the 
front of the studio once again――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four~ Heave-ho, 
heave-ho~âª

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, you're the guest who came by 
earlier, aren't you? How are you feeling 
today~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A cool down, you say...? My, it has 
already gotten this late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I ended up overdoing my warm-up a little 
too much~
choice_data_list:
Nonstop since this morning... 
documentaries and all?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, since this is a new dance routine 
to learn, I wanted to be thoroughly 
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's not enough time to memorize 
the crucial dance choreography. Whatever 
shall we do~?
choice_data_list:
Why not focus on the parts that bother you 
most?

Why not try memorizing a rough outline of 
the whole thing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see, what a wonderful proposal~. Then 
let us ensure we thoroughly tackle our 
weak points~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Mejiro Bright finally 
started her dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see~ It really is important to take a 
swooosh through the overall flow first, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall test it out at once~. Thank you 
very much for your invaluable advice~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Mejiro Bright finally 
started her dance practice.
